meta.title: One prompt. Every model.
meta.description: An open benchmark: every model builds the same weather card. Raw outputs, deterministic similarity, and blind community preference — you pick the winner.

hero.kicker: open benchmark · deterministic data · community preference
hero.sub: Every model gets the same ask: build a weather card. We publish every raw output, measure pairwise similarity deterministically, and let the community vote — blind — on which cards they prefer to look at.

gate.title: Three blind picks unlock the gallery
gate.sub: Two anonymous cards, identical live data. Pick the one you prefer — identities reveal after each choice. Your picks become open community-preference data.
